category_story: Same mlp1 scope as DP1 (94% of positions hurt >0.5 nats): dominant failure modes are subword continuations and fixed multi-word templates -- a common phrasal collocation like 'turned out' falls into the same broad token-table bucket rather than needing a dedicated bigram head.
